title: Stonier Vineyard Tours & New Release Pinot Tasting
summary: Winemakers and owners walk you through the Stonier property and pour the new 2025 Pinot Noir on its first weekend of release. Four sessions across Sunday and Monday of King's Birthday weekend.
priceRange: Free for KBS Wine Club members
weatherDependency: Outdoor walk through vineyard; dress warmly for June
nearbyAttractions: Stonier Pies & Pinot (same weekend); Winter Wine Festival
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Friday/Saturday Winter Wine Festival then visit Stonier Sunday/Monday for the tour
kidsGradeNote: Adult tasting plus a working vineyard walk, not built for kids.
editorVerdict: The closest you'll get on the Peninsula to walking a vineyard with the person who farms it. Free for club members, which is a quiet bargain.
editorNote:
Four sessions across Sunday 7 and Monday 8 June, the back half of the King's Birthday long weekend. Stonier winemakers and owners take small groups through the property, then pour the just-released 2025 Pinot Noir alongside library wines in the cellar door. Free for KBS Wine Club members. Non-member pricing wasn't published at time of writing, ring the cellar door.

For Pinot drinkers who want context before they buy. Combine with the Saturday Winter Wine Festival at Red Hill Showgrounds and you have the complete weekend.

Dress warm, the walk is exposed and June on the ridge bites. Sessions are small so book by phone as soon as the program goes live.
